verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents official, published SDKs for Python (PyPI `helix-db` 0.3.4), TypeScript (`@helix-db/helix-db` 3.1.0) and Go, plus Rust, all sharing one operation-tree request model. Java, one of the four languages named in the story, never appears in the evidence. Missing for 10: an official Java SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against official SDKs in the major languages (Python, TypeScript, Go, Java)

citations.quote: HelixDB v3 uses one operation-tree request model across the Rust, TypeScript, Go, and Python SDKs.
The Python SDK is published on PyPI as `helix-db` 0.3.4 and imported as `helixdb`.
The published `@helix-db/helix-db` 3.1.0 package targets Node.js 20 or newer
The Go SDK builds the shared operation-tree AST and executes requests through a typed HTTP client.
